description: We’re building a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer — a fun, browser-based game that teaches kids real astronaut skills through hands-on missions. Think playful space adventures backed by actual NASA concepts. Our goal: make a polished, award-worthy entry. We’re a passionate team strong in game dev, web, and AI, and we’re looking for teammates who love coding, game design, art/animation, and storytelling. Come help us send kids to space! 🚀
